verse.verse_1: When the Event inevitable cometh to pass,
verse.verse_2: Then will no (soul) entertain falsehood concerning its coming.
verse.verse_3: (Many) will it bring low; (many) will it exalt;
verse.verse_4: When the earth shall be shaken to its depths,
verse.verse_5: And the mountains shall be crumbled to atoms,
verse.verse_7: And ye shall be sorted out into three classes.
verse.verse_8: Then (there will be) the Companions of the Right Hand;- What will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
verse.verse_9: And the Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
verse.verse_10: And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).
verse.verse_11: These will be those Nearest to Allah:
verse.verse_13: A number of people from those of old,
verse.verse_14: And a few from those of later times.
verse.verse_15: (They will be) on Thrones encrusted (with gold and precious stones),
verse.verse_16: Reclining on them, facing each other.
verse.verse_17: Round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness),
verse.verse_18: With goblets, (shining) beakers, and cups (filled) out of clear-flowing fountains:
verse.verse_19: No after-ache will they receive therefrom, nor will they suffer intoxication:
verse.verse_20: And with fruits, any that they may select:
verse.verse_21: And the flesh of fowls, any that they may desire.
verse.verse_22: And (there will be) Companions with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes,-
verse.verse_24: A Reward for the deeds of their past (life).
verse.verse_25: Not frivolity will they hear therein, nor any taint of ill,-
verse.verse_27: The Companions of the Right Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
verse.verse_28: (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,
verse.verse_29: Among Talh trees with flowers (or fruits) piled one above another,-
verse.verse_33: Whose season is not limited, nor (supply) forbidden,
verse.verse_34: And on Thrones (of Dignity), raised high.
verse.verse_35: We have created (their Companions) of special creation.
verse.verse_36: And made them virgin - pure (and undefiled), -
verse.verse_38: For the Companions of the Right Hand.
verse.verse_39: A (goodly) number from those of old,
verse.verse_40: And a (goodly) number from those of later times.
verse.verse_41: The Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
verse.verse_42: (They will be) in the midst of a Fierce Blast of Fire and in Boiling Water,
verse.verse_43: And in the shades of Black Smoke:
verse.verse_44: Nothing (will there be) to refresh, nor to please:
verse.verse_45: For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),
verse.verse_46: And persisted obstinately in wickedness supreme!
verse.verse_47: And they used to say, "What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be raised up again?-
verse.verse_49: Say: "Yea, those of old and those of later times,
verse.verse_50: "All will certainly be gathered together for the meeting appointed for a Day well-known.
verse.verse_51: "Then will ye truly,- O ye that go wrong, and treat (Truth) as Falsehood!-
verse.verse_52: "Ye will surely taste of the Tree of Zaqqum.
verse.verse_53: "Then will ye fill your insides therewith,
verse.verse_54: "And drink Boiling Water on top of it:
verse.verse_55: "Indeed ye shall drink like diseased camels raging with thirst!"
verse.verse_56: Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!
verse.verse_57: It is We Who have created you: why will ye not witness the Truth?
verse.verse_58: Do ye then see?- The (human Seed) that ye throw out,-
verse.verse_59: Is it ye who create it, or are We the Creators?
verse.verse_60: We have decreed Death to be your common lot, and We are not to be frustrated
verse.verse_61: from changing your Forms and creating you (again) in (forms) that ye know not.
verse.verse_62: And ye certainly know already the first form of creation: why then do ye not celebrate His praises?
verse.verse_63: See ye the seed that ye sow in the ground?
verse.verse_64: Is it ye that cause it to grow, or are We the Cause?
verse.verse_65: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry powder, and ye would be left in wonderment,
verse.verse_66: (Saying), "We are indeed left with debts (for nothing):
verse.verse_67: "Indeed are we shut out (of the fruits of our labour)"
verse.verse_68: See ye the water which ye drink?
verse.verse_69: Do ye bring it down (in rain) from the cloud or do We?
verse.verse_70: Were it Our Will, We could make it salt (and unpalatable): then why do ye not give thanks?
verse.verse_71: See ye the Fire which ye kindle?
verse.verse_72: Is it ye who grow the tree which feeds the fire, or do We grow it?
verse.verse_73: We have made it a memorial (of Our handiwork), and an article of comfort and convenience for the denizens of deserts.
verse.verse_74: Then celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme!
verse.verse_75: Furthermore I call to witness the setting of the Stars,-
verse.verse_76: And that is indeed a mighty adjuration if ye but knew,-
verse.verse_77: That this is indeed a qur'an Most Honourable,
verse.verse_79: Which none shall touch but those who are clean:
verse.verse_80: A Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
verse.verse_81: Is it such a Message that ye would hold in light esteem?
verse.verse_82: And have ye made it your livelihood that ye should declare it false?
verse.verse_83: Then why do ye not (intervene) when (the soul of the dying man) reaches the throat,-
verse.verse_84: And ye the while (sit) looking on,-
verse.verse_85: But We are nearer to him than ye, and yet see not,-
verse.verse_86: Then why do ye not,- If you are exempt from (future) account,-
verse.verse_87: Call back the soul, if ye are true (in the claim of independence)?
verse.verse_88: Thus, then, if he be of those Nearest to Allah,
verse.verse_89: (There is for him) Rest and Satisfaction, and a Garden of Delights.
verse.verse_90: And if he be of the Companions of the Right Hand,
verse.verse_91: (For him is the salutation), "Peace be unto thee", from the Companions of the Right Hand.
verse.verse_92: And if he be of those who treat (Truth) as Falsehood, who go wrong,
verse.verse_93: For him is Entertainment with Boiling Water.
verse.verse_95: Verily, this is the Very Truth and Certainly.
verse.verse_96: So celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme.
